notes.title: Interview with Jeffrey Montoya - Exploring the Music that Inspired the Hunt
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Hunters,[/p][p][/p][p]As we embark on Mateo Lombardo’s grim journey, we caught up with [b]Jeffrey Montoya[/b], the music composer, writer and one of the key creative minds at Migami Games. [/p][p][/p][p]In this special Q&A, he discusses the inspirations behind the [i]Chronicles of the Wolf [/i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795940/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf_Soundtrack/"]soundtrack[/url][/u], its challenges and influences that sets the tone for Mateo’s adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/897b8e0b38d169caa13d50f301c81df48bc0832c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: What were your musical influences and inspirations for the soundtrack of Chronicles of the Wolf?[/b][/p][p]I was definitely inspired by the Castlevania soundtracks I’ve listened to throughout my life, and the films I’ve seen and loved from all eras. A few specific artists that have inspired me throughout my life are: Michiru Yamane, Wojciech Kilar, Trent Reznor, Goblin, Danny Elfman, Billy Corgan, Joe Hisashi and Branislav Zivkovic.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: How did you approach writing the music during development?[/b][/p][p]I learned how to structure soundtracks writing to videos of completed levels sent by Mig throughout development of our fangame, Castlevania The Lecarde Chronicles 2. I always prefer to know what I am writing for beforehand.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/b35c163c17ac6632f924c8190fd1b2d052fcc408.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: How did your work on Wallachia differ from Chronicles of the Wolf?[/b][/p][p]I developed my craft further with Wallachia bringing in more guitars and real vocals, but that Original Soundtrack was very different by its linear nature and faster pace.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/2ed97c0ecf254ff941e2fc71863f7d697f491b0a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: What was your vision for the Chronicles of the Wolf soundtrack?[/b][/p][p]I wanted to make a soundtrack like LC2 again, but free of course, of Castlevania cover songs and with a heavy emphasis on real, performed instruments. Most importantly I wanted to write music that follows the player like a friend or a shadow that lingers in their thoughts after playing.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Were you aiming for a polished orchestral feel or something else entirely?[/b][/p][p]I didn’t want to make a perfect sounding orchestral style original soundtrack. I wanted something rougher and more visceral with the emotion and rough edges of a rock band.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: What tools and instruments did you rely on for creating the soundtrack?[/b][/p][p]After I knew what I wanted to do, I went around to different music shops looking for a keyboard with great onboard sounds that could be used as the heart of the original soundtrack. I landed on a modestly priced Yamaha keyboard that I thought captured the retro vibe perfectly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/c5b6125123123b6c5b4acb38fa13e953b6741ed8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: How much of the soundtrack was performed live versus digitally composed?[/b][/p][p]90% of everything you hear in the [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] soundtrack is either played from that keyboard, my guitars, my Roland V drum kit, and my voice. I performed as much as I could by hand and practiced self restraint in editing to convey the raw emotion behind the parts as much as possible.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Can you walk us through a typical day in your recording process?[/b][/p][p]A typical day of recording would involve me going in a circle in my office from drums, to piano, to guitars/bass, and vocals usually last.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Did you face any challenges during recording, and how did you overcome them?[/b][/p][p]Countless hours were also spent in practice as I never really considered myself a piano player before. I sometimes would have to spend hours rehearsing the more difficult parts before I recorded them. It was difficult and almost broke me at times. But I stuck it out to the end and I’ve grown as a musician a lot from it.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Why did you limit yourself to using only real instruments, and what effect did that have on your process?[/b][/p][p]I feel by imposing limitations on myself to only use songs I write on real instruments and not with mouse clicks, I was able to focus while staying true to the game and myself as an artist.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: How did you manage self-doubt throughout the process, and what kept you going?[/b][/p][p]I had to get over my own self doubt as a musician, and I definitely felt the pressure. But I have a wonderfully supportive wife and daughter who helped me to persevere and deliver the best work I am capable of.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Any unexpected companions during development you’d like to mention?[/b][/p][p]Our dog Elena was by my side for most of it too. You can say hi to her in the final village of the game. She’s the tan one. Couldn’t have done it without her![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/e2079e6fa0e2b399ad04a7d1688be8a6c0232145.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795940/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf_Soundtrack/"]The Chronicles of the Wolf: The Original Soundtrack[/url] is coming soon to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795940/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf_Soundtrack/"]Steam[/url], so you’ll be able to relive the game’s haunting melodies anytime, anywhere. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/f15b3e15a8cf9655ce6ee3274fa101877bc6819b.png"][/img][/p][p]As a heartfelt thank you to the community, composer Jeffrey has generously uploaded the full soundtrack to YouTube ahead of time so fans can immerse themselves in the music even before the official release. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, and crank it loud. 
[/p][p]👁️ Sign up to Learn More:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/4dwqdRe"]https://bit.ly/4dwqdRe[/url][/p][p]
Watch the Launch Trailer:
[/p][previewyoutube="noouymdWEf8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf – 🛠 Patch Notes 📝
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Hunters,[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you all for the incredible support following the launch of [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i]! [/p][p] [/p][p]We’ve been listening carefully to all the feedback and as a result we have just released our [b]first[/b] post-launch patch. [/p][p] [/p][p]Below are the full patch notes including some quality of life fixes that should help smooth out your journey across Gévaudan.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🛠 Patch Notes Summary[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Keyboard controls are now working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard prompts are functioning correctly during tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]The ESC key now opens the in-game menu.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Spanish version, the word [b]“quitar”[/b] has been replaced with [b]“salir.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Hospital level[/b], only one furnace remains operational to help players with FPS issues progress.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Killer Plant[/b] enemy stats have been corrected in the Monster Chart.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting the [b]Relics[/b] section now properly returns you to the correct menu line.[/p][/*][*][p]The text in front of the first [b]save statue[/b] has been updated to clearly indicate that you must press [b]UP[/b] in front of the statue.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Chronicles Master[/b] trophy has been restored. For players who had unlocked everything except this trophy before the patch, simply enter the game and load a save file where you have defeated the Beast a second time — the trophy will pop.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Gauntlet[/b] behind the third door in [b]Apcher Castle[/b] has been simplified. There is now always a platform underneath for “leap of faith”-style jumps.[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling mistakes have been corrected in one of the endings and in the credit roll.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]💡 Recommendations:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We suggest players check whether their [b]antivirus[/b] is causing long loading times — this is often the case.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes, [b]Steam Input[/b] needs to be manually enabled or disabled to resolve controller issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding [b]recordings[/b] on platforms like Twitch: Recording works perfectly in FULL SCREEN mode. In windowed mode, parts of the game that open in a separate window may not be captured correctly. Players need to configure their setup to record both windows.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all your support and for joining us on this journey. Just so you know, we’re still listening, updating and improving the experience so, please keep your eyes peeled![/p][p] [/p][p][i]The Chronicles of the Wolf Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Thank you for Playing and Please Share Your Experience!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Hunters![/p][p]
From all of us at PQube, Migami, and PixelHeart, thank you for joining the hunt in Chronicles of the Wolf! 🐺🗡️[/p][p]
Your kind messages, streams, videos and excitement have meant the world to us. Seeing so many of you brave the cursed forests of Gévaudan alongside Mateo has truly warmed our wild hearts.[/p][p]
The issues concerning mouse and keyboard have not gone unheard. Thank you for reporting those control issues. Our team is hot on the trail, and improvements are already in the works.[/p][p]
[b]If you’ve enjoyed your first moon run, leaving a positive review would be a huge help. Every kind word helps guide new adventurers into the darkness.[/b][/p][p]
And remember… just because you’ve faced the Beast once doesn’t mean the hunt is over. The shadows of Gévaudan still hide many secrets. 🔍🌕[/p][p]
Stay vigilant, and happy hunting.[/p][p]
– The Chronicles of the Wolf team[/p]

notes.title: Mouse and Keyboard Support Removed Temporarily
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]Due to a last-minute bug, we have temporarily removed support for mouse and keyboard controls.[/p][p][/p][p]The issue prevents players from using a mouse and keyboard after reloading a game save. However, you can continue playing with a controller while we work on a fix. Your save data will still function correctly with a controller.[/p][p][/p][p]This bug only affects mouse and keyboard users. Players using a controller are not affected.[/p][p][/p][p]We will update you as soon as this is fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience.[/p]

notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf is Out Now
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Adventurer,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The time has now come for you to fulfil your destiny.[/p][p][/p][p]The wait is over, metroidvania fans can now rejoice as [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i], the haunting new action-platformer from iconic developer [b]Migami Games[/b], is now ready to take top spot in your games library.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="noouymdWEf8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Early Reviews[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]“Chronicles of the Wolf is a magnificent spiritual successor to the Castlevanias that followed the metroidvania structure.” [/i][/p][p][b]90%[/b] – [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fpsxbrasil.com.br%2Fchronicles-of-the-wolf-review%2F"][u]PSX Brasil[/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]“Fans of Castlevania will absolutely lap this Chronicles of the Wolf.”[/i][/p][p][b]85%[/b] – [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Flootlevelchill.com%2Freviews%2Fchronicles-of-the-wolf-review%2F"][u]Loot Level Chill[/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]“If you love the old-school Castlevania games then you'll adore Chronicles of the Wolf so get ready to slay monsters on an epic adventure.”[/i][/p][p][b]80%[/b] – [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvideochums.com%2Farticle%2F6-adventure-games-and-puzzlers-for-console%23chronicles-of-the-wolf"][u]Video Chums[/u][/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Stunning Gothic Adventure Awaits[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/fa4c1cb0011179d9b774c2eea31ad027bb96e55d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Take up the mantle of [b]Mateo Lombardo[/b], the last apprentice of the ancient [b]Rose Cross Order[/b], as you hunt the terrifying [b]Beast of Gévaudan[/b] – a creature pulled straight from 18th century legend and reimagined in a stunning, pixel-gothic world. [/p][p][/p][p]With over 100 unique enemies and an epic journey based on real-world legend, the experience is a dream come true for fans of the genre. Littered with hidden paths, dark secrets, brutal bosses and multiple endings your first run would just be scratching the surface of this Migami masterpiece.[/p][p]Expect tight combat, challenging enemies, and gorgeous gothic environments with a dynamic day-night cycle that changes everything.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/dedee8f2a2f69e9b2803c9a8e4ff15f3c87012e6.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Genuine Gaming Talent with Real Credibility[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/624b228aca72d7a09ec66472a678439bd9ad07c7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Narration by [b]Robert Belgrade[/b], legendary voice of Alucard ([i]Castlevania: Symphony of the Night[/i]), as well as fan-favourite roles from [i]Tekken[/i], [i]Mega Man X7 (Signas) and Soul Blade (Rock).[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/1c776d6e26b15016588a36ad565060264ed6620d.png"][/img][/p][p]Original soundtrack by [b]Jeffrey Montoya[/b], with a powerful guest track from [b]Óscar Araujo[/b], acclaimed composer of [i]Castlevania: Lords of Shadow[/i], [i]Lords of Shadow 2,[/i] and the cult film [i]Neon Flesh[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/59e400b1ea936f74c02651c8ec2c17c7a709bc3b.jpg"][/img][i]“Bloodstained” is a trademark and/or registered trademark of ArtPlay, Inc.. Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night is developed by Artplay, Inc.. Published by 505 Games S.p.A
[/i][/p][p]Special guest appearance by [b]Bloodless[/b] from [i]Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night[/i], voiced by [b]Kira Buckland[/b] ([i]NieR: Automata[/i], [i]Genshin Impact[/i], [i]Street Fighter V[/i]).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/69e72d26697e8689b2d8c99a31ba205e7b384851.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Be the True Knight[/b] – Step into the boots of Mateo Lombardo and rise to greatness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloodless Joins the Fight[/b] – Guest star Bloodless from [i]Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night[/i] makes a special appearance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hunt the Beast[/b] – Track and face the legendary Beast of Gévaudan in a thrilling quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conquer Brutal Bosses[/b] – Test your skills against powerful enemies promising intense battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore Vast Castles[/b] – Discover sprawling areas packed with secrets, puzzles, and danger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock Powerful Abilities[/b] – Gain upgrades and power-ups to forge your path to victory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stunning Storytelling[/b] – Immerse yourself in illustrated cutscenes and narration by the iconic [b]Robert Belgrade[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Uncover Dark Secrets[/b] – Dive into a haunting tale and reveal the truth behind the Beast[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey – the hunt for the bloodthirsty [i]Beast of Gévaudan[/i] begins now and we wish you well.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay brave, stay sharp.[/p][p][/p][p]— The [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Interview with Jeffrey Montoya - Co-producer/Composer/Voice Actor/Pixel Artist
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Hunters,[/p][p][/p][p]We have something truly special for you today, [/p][p][/p][p]As we prepare to embark on Mateo Lombardo’s grim journey next week, we caught up with [b]Jeffrey Montoya[/b], the music composer, writer and one of the key creative minds at Migami Games. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/897b8e0b38d169caa13d50f301c81df48bc0832c.png"][/img][/p][p]In this special Q&A, he discusses the inspirations behind [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i], its historical foundations and how the team brought this haunting metroidvania to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/fa4c1cb0011179d9b774c2eea31ad027bb96e55d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: Where did the initial idea for [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] come from?
[/b]What motivated you to make another metroidvania? Was this always going to follow in the footsteps of [i]The Lecarde Chronicles 2[/i]?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/5d30daf4dc3ae8362e4ecbf8bb3d136a487fc536.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]The initial inspiration for [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] stemmed from our desire to make a spiritual successor to our 2017 fangame, [i]Castlevania The Lecarde Chronicles 2[/i]. We knew that we wanted to make a metroidvania like that again, but polished and set within a shared continuity with our previous title, the historically-inspired [i]Wallachia: Reign of Dracula[/i].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/94f3594ec9b497f346a85a96dcc4fa08e545789f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: What sort of research went into crafting the story and setting?
[/b]How did you land on the Beast of Gévaudan as the game’s central myth?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/aa9280cfe6f7f40973c4453d201cdfb009d1e81b.jpg"][/img][b]Credit:[/b] [i]The film's copyright is owned by [/i][url="http://www.davis-films.com/"]Davis Films[/url][b][i], [/i][/b][url="https://www.studiocanal.com/title/brotherhood-of-the-wolf-2001/"]Studio Canal France[/url][b][i], and [/i][/b][url="https://www.studiotf1.com/"]TF1 Films Production[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]I spent some time researching different settings and ideas for our game while Mig started building the game’s engine. I rediscovered the historical events of the mysterious 18th-century Beast of Gévaudan attacks, which took place in southern France. It was a mystifying case I had heard about decades prior from the French film, [i]Brotherhood of the Wolf[/i].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/de8de3630f0866c0be7c6a6696ffdcdd3e80c7e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: What made the Beast of Gévaudan stand out to you as a villain?
[/b]Why do you think this piece of history hasn’t been explored more in fiction?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/dedee8f2a2f69e9b2803c9a8e4ff15f3c87012e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]There is a shockingly small amount of media and fiction built around the Beast of Gévaudan and I thought it would make the perfect antagonist after Vlad the Impaler in [i]Wallachia: Reign of Dracula[/i].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/b5299dfb0f66931e7496d2ab84e741397050ccc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: Was the historical era a good fit for the game’s tone and gameplay?[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/d75ae9111d81c44e37d5db9386991013cd3f5afd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]It was auspicious that the history of the Beast was set in the same gothic era as our [i]Lecarde Chronicles[/i] games, and it was a great bonus that it took place in the county which Mig resides. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/9e65019ec3e0862c21837616b0057993c7473129.jpg"][/img][/p][p]He even took a road trip through the region of Gévaudan for inspiration during development![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/29c2a8a275e15c4cf7306b1bb36aab7d1de4e107.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: Tell us about Mateo Lombardo — who is he, and how does he fit into the world of [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i]?
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/b3a0cacd95ab0b4bc41c560005349068913a0641.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]Turning to the hero of the game, Mateo Lombardo is an apprentice of the Rose Cross Order, which also has historical roots. He is on a quest to become a Knight of the Rose Cross Order by slaying the infamous Beast. I think this is very fitting in a metroidvania game where you gradually become more powerful throughout, like a coming-of-age story. And so you are the young apprentice, left to prove himself.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: Mateo is a silent protagonist. Why did you choose that approach?
[/b]How do you think it impacts the way players experience the game?[/p][p][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]Players will notice that Mateo is a mostly silent hero. We love this style of storytelling in games as it keeps the dialogue fast, and helps the character maintain a degree of anonymity, which can help make the experience feel more intimate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/815f13cf9dde4113f031a48805bc602d3b4e8604.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Q: Any final thoughts or hopes you have for the players picking up the game?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]A:
[/b]I hope players enjoy the scenes and the vibes we created with this one! I am forever grateful and humbled to have gotten to be a part of this amazing team of artists![/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks for joining us on this fascinating behind-the-scenes glimpse into [b]Chronicles of the Wolf[/b] with Jeffrey Montoya. We hope this look into the game’s roots has sharpened your blade and stirred your curiosity.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay tuned for the next blog post interview with Jeffrey where we discuss the music that brings life to Mateo's adventure through Gévaudan. Until then… keep your torch lit and your reflexes sharp for the [b]19th June[/b]![/i][/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ Wishlist the game, play the demo and follow for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2371890/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf/?snr=1_5_9_"]Play the free demo now and begin your journey[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]👁️ Sign up to Learn More: [/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/4dwqdRe"]https://bit.ly/4dwqdRe[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OOOht_CesDs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf: A Dark Tale Inspired by History & Mystery
notes.notes:
Greetings, Hunters,

It's not too long to go until the [i][b]19th June 2025[/b][/i], when [b][i]Chronicles of the Wolf [/i][/b]officially launches on Steam. To prepare you for this epic adventure, it would only be fitting to give a brief insight into the bloody history that inspired the journey you will undertake with Mateo Lombardo.

[i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] teleports you into a world where myth bleeds into reality. The immersive metroidvania gameplay is weaved with two powerful strands of real-world lore: the secretive Rose Cross Order and the chilling legend of the [i]Beast of Gévaudan[/i].

[h3]🐺 The Beast of Gévaudan: Real-World Horror[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/a3716ff468c7b97e3a98da2f2f40e88499291384.png[/img]
Between 1764 and 1767, rural France was gripped by terror. A monstrous creature stalked the countryside, killing over 100 people. It was no ordinary wolf. Survivors described it as massive, unnatural with reddish fur and an almost human-like posture. Today, it’s remembered as the [i]Beast of Gévaudan[/i], a historical mystery that is still prominent in modern pop-culture and folklore across the globe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/dedee8f2a2f69e9b2803c9a8e4ff15f3c87012e6.gif[/img]

In the game, the Beast is more than a myth; it is your nightmare, stalking you as you progress. You will always be thinking, [i]"who is hunting who?"[/i] Each boss fight, environmental hazard and haunting ruin you encounter builds toward a showdown with this legendary terror. Will you face it with courage or, succumb to it's hunger like it's many victims?

[h3]🎮 Where History Meets Gameplay[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/b5299dfb0f66931e7496d2ab84e741397050ccc6.jpg[/img]
[i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] doesn't just reference history, it builds its gameplay around it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/2b671c352cb65e826dd0cedf55b275a83ad13289.jpg[/img]
🏰 Traverse an interconnected world based on 18th-century France, from ruined cathedrals to dense, cursed forests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/f223cdc6b323dce6e2bf48c6e5d2b01d69c179e7.jpg[/img]
🌒 Navigate an ever-changing world where light fades and new threats rise with the dark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/2aa51f6891fcf545e32156c256ddecdab009d1c0.jpg[/img]
⚔️ Battle through brutal boss encounters, each one a twisted reflection of regional folklore and inner corruption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/faaf7760943de78e4cd20feae63c2f96339e9f15.jpg[/img]
✨ Harness the teachings of the Rose Cross, unlocking powerful relics, combat upgrades and hidden paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/fa4c1cb0011179d9b774c2eea31ad027bb96e55d.jpg[/img]
